column1: # The Haskell port's hand-decided names: old <TAB> new (new == old keeps the name).
# Record-field prefixes of this port, which the glossary reads differently: ss is ScanState
# (not C's string stream), ie is ImmExpr (not the interrupt-enable bit), in is Instruction,
# lbl is Label, opt is the options, Ev an assembler event, V a token value, reg the register file.
# Words with more than one meaning, decided as in the C core.
# Kept: English words (at, in as a preposition), the R/I/J formats, the grammar shapes, the
# float/double helper suffixes (binaryS, setS: single), numeric helpers, the file descriptor.
# Collisions the -Werror build found: Prelude names (length would shadow Prelude.length).
